Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION[LSDLayeredSel: Version number for the Layered Selection Display mod installed.
LSD_LAYERED_SELECTION_DISPLAY_DESCRIPTIO: For removing surfaces inside or outside of buildings in one click.
LSDLayeredSelectionDisplay.TOOLTIP_DESCR: Either selects all or none of the Filters depending on your current selection. Having none selected will prevent the Bulldoze Tool from working.
Toggling this off will prevent the Bulldoze Tool from removing Building assets.
Toggling this off will prevent the Bulldoze Tool from removing Network assets such as roads, tracks, and powerlines.
Toggling this off will prevent the Bulldoze Tool from removing trees and wild bushes.
Toggling this off will prevent the Bulldoze Tool from removing plants that are not trees such as cultivated bushes and potted plants.
Toggling this off will prevent the Bulldoze Tool from removing decals.
Toggling this off will prevent the Bulldoze Tool from removing any props that are not trees, plants, or decals.
Toggling this off will prevent the Bulldoze Tool from removing surfaces.
Click any asset from the list to open its info panel.
